YOUR MUSIC, CONNECTED

Listening room settings

Google Drive

Sign in to read the music in your folder. Audio downloads directly from Google into this browser; it is never added to the website or GitHub repository.

One-time setup: enable the Google Drive API and create a Web application OAuth client with this website’s origin. Google requests read-only Drive access; Lowtide lists only the folder you choose. Open Google Cloud ↗

Cover art

Covers match song filenames automatically. Open a music folder with its artwork subfolder, use Add covers, or load your private Drive artwork here.

Uses the Google client ID above. Covers stay in this browser and load as you browse; they are not published to GitHub. JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and GIF are supported.

Playback

Beat sync matches reliable intro/outro beat grids with speed changes of up to ±6%. Like vinyl, speed changes also shift pitch slightly. Weak, irregular, or widely different beats use a gentle crossfade. Gold waveform marks show estimated phrase boundaries. Phrase matching assumes steady 4/4 music, aligns supported boundaries over 8, 16 or 32 bars, and prefers less busy overlaps. Uncertain structure uses beat matching. Longer blends need more steady audio; short tracks use shorter transitions. Keep this device awake for uninterrupted playback.

Phrase cue for this track

Play a track to set its phrase cue.

If the estimate is wrong, enter a known phrase start or use the current position. The cue snaps to the nearest detected beat and repeats at the chosen phrase length. Saved cues apply to future transitions on this device.
